name: iOS Simulators
description: Boot, open and erase simulators; stream their logs.

list.title: ${name}
list.command: xcrun simctl list devices available -j | python3 -c "import json,sys; [print(json.dumps(dict(d, runtime=r.split('.')[-1].replace('-', ' ', 1).replace('-', '.')))) for r, ds in json.load(sys.stdin)['devices'].items() for d in ds]"
list.subtitle: ${runtime} · ${state}

actions.title: Stream Logs
actions.terminal: xcrun simctl spawn ${udid} log stream --level info

actions.title: Erase
actions.confirm: Erase all content and settings of ${name}?
